settings.label: Delivery
settings.sub: Where we deliver, how long it takes, tracking
settings.body:
We currently ship within India. Orders are packed and dispatched within 2 business days, and delivery takes up to 7 days from the day you order. You’ll get a tracking link by email once your parcel is on its way. Any shipping charge is shown at checkout before you pay.

Not arrived within 7 days? Email us with your order number and we’ll chase it for you.

settings.label: Returns
settings.sub: What can come back, and how
settings.body:
You can return a set within 15 days of delivery if it’s unused and unopened, in its original packaging with the seal intact.

If your set arrives damaged, defective or isn’t what you ordered, email us within 15 days of delivery with your order number and a photo. We’ll send a replacement or a full refund, including any shipping you paid.

To start a return, email us within 15 days of delivery with your order number and the reason, and we’ll tell you where to send it. For change-of-mind returns, return shipping is on you; for damaged, defective or wrong items, we cover it.

Refunds go back to your original payment method within 7 business days of us receiving and checking the return.

We don’t offer direct exchanges right now. Return the set for a refund and place a new order for the one you want.

settings.label: Fit & application
settings.sub: Sizing, putting them on, taking them off

settings.label: Orders
settings.body:
Need to change your delivery address? Email us as soon as you can. We can update it while your order is still being packed, but not once it’s been dispatched.

Want to cancel? You can, for a full refund, any time before your order is dispatched. Email us with your order number.

settings.heading: Still need help?
settings.intro: Send us a message and we’ll reply by email.
settings.success: Got it, thank you. We’ll reply to the email you gave us.
